title: Pink-haired Warrior Poses
description: Four sequential poses of the same female character with bright pink hair in pigtails, wearing a dark armored dress with green accents, a small crown, and a green cape. She stands against a solid bright green background in increasingly aggressive stances, from neutral to a dynamic fighting pose with one arm extended.
prompt: A cartoon female character with voluminous pink hair in high pigtails and a small golden crown, wearing a dark armored dress with green scalloped edges, green shoulder pads, gloves, boots, and a flowing green cape. She is shown in four distinct standing poses side by side against a solid lime green background, progressing from neutral stance to an aggressive fighting pose with fist extended, in a clean 2D animation style.
